content:
Alisa: Pushed a compact-list prototype for the credentials page. Goal: fit more keys per screen for power users. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789
Mike: Visually neat but hitting concerns: touch targets and keyboard users. Please keep interactive row height >= 44px. :iphone:
Sasha: Also the inline revoke button looks visually heavy next to the key name. High accidental-click risk. Can we move it into a kebab menu or hide behind hover for mouse?
Dinesh: Compact rows also compress the drag handle and focus outlines. We should test with 200% text scaling and VoiceOver.
Alisa: Added a variant that keeps visual density but expands invisible hit area for actions. Also tried a subtle left color bar for role pills to help scanning.
Kevin: Role pills idea is nice. For color bar, ensure contrast meets 4.5:1 and add an explicit aria-label like "permission: admin" for screen readers.
Michelle: Revoke flow copy: current: "Revoke key?" Proposed: "Revoke API key — stops all traffic immediately. Undo available for 30s." Add an inline undo toast.
Sasha: If we advertise undo, backend must support it deterministically. @ui-bot can you confirm staging status?
ui-bot: Feature flag `revoke_undo` = off in staging. Backend endpoint `POST /keys/{id}/undo` exists but is rate-limited and gated by flag.
Mike: So for rollout, copy should be conditional on the flag. If flag off, use irreversible language and link to docs for rotation best practices.
Dinesh: QA checklist for the change: 1) Tab order (action then details), 2) Focus visible on row and on pills, 3) Touchable >=44px, 4) ARIA on modals with focus trap, 5) color contrast for badges.
Alisa: Noted. Also considering created-at column: compact mode hides it, but audit teams rely on it. Plan: keep it in a details flyout rather than the main table. Thoughts?
Kevin: Flyout is fine but ensure it's discoverable for keyboard users (enter/space to open). Also add keyboard shortcut hint in the header.
Michelle: Empty state needs rewriting when using compact list. Current empty state feels too sparse. Suggest: title "Create your first API key", body "Start calling Redwood Inference by creating an API key. Use scoped permissions for safety.", primary CTA "Create API key", secondary link "Scopes & least privilege".
Sasha: Accessibility nit: danger modal should include aria-live polite region for status and ensure screen reader reads the server-side revoke result (success/error). Right now focus jumps to page body and nothing is announced.
Dinesh: Implementation note: invisible padding is good but watch for layout shift when expanding hit areas. That can break visual alignment.
Alisa: Action items: 1) I'll update figma with 44px min row variant + invisible hit areas, 2) add created-at in details flyout, 3) draft conditional revoke modal copy depending on `revoke_undo` flag, 4) update empty state copy. Will ping when updated.
Mike: Can design add a short PR checklist entry so eng remembers keyboard + a11y tests?
Alisa: Added checklist in the figma comments and PR template. Thanks all! :rocket:
